id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c028: "Big sister Gabriel's singing voice is so lovely.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c088: "Look, even my friend Mimi is moved by the song. She's sniffling to hold back her tears.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c198: "Hey, Mimi. Lately big sister Hannah hasn't come back to the room at night...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c22c: "The teachers say we can't go outside at night, so what is big sister doing...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c334: "Since the day Yggdrasil fell, we mustn't go outside carelessly. We're preparing for emergencies.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c3f0: "What kind of emergency, I wonder. Do you know, big brother? I don't really get it.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c550: "I was taught that a king from some country founded Medal Academy, but I don't think he was a real king, ya see.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c640: "A king should be rich. I don't think he'd want something as plain as tiny medals as treasure, ya see.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c78c: "My roommate Bridget has been acting strange lately, ya see. I'm so worried I can't sleep at night.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c848: "She skips class, doesn't sleep at night, sometimes bursts into tears, and won't tell me why, ya see.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c91c: "Bridget is usually a cheerful, popular girl. But now... what on earth happened, ya see.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ca34: "Mmm... Bridget is mumbling this late at night again, ya see...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|caa0: "Things like 'I won't give up' and 'There must still be a chance'... I don't get it at all, ya see...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cb88: "Mister, take what Toki says with a grain of salt, ya see. That girl is a real tomboy.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cc4c: "She pranks us and lies to surprise us, and gets away with it all with that cute face, ya see.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cdcc: "I just enrolled in this school, so I have no idea what a lovely lady even is.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d184: "I just enrolled in this school, so I have no idea what a lovely lady even is.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d914: "I just enrolled in this school, so I have no idea what a lovely lady even is.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ce78: "If I do these exercises every day like the older girls say, will I really become a lovely lady...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cf8c: "Are you the new student everyone's talking about, big brother? Hehe, then I'm a tiny bit your senior!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d71c: "Are you the new student everyone's talking about, big brother? Hehe, then I'm a tiny bit your senior!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d03c: "If you're troubled at a girls' school, tell me anything. As your senior, I'll listen to your worries.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d7cc: "If you're troubled at a girls' school, tell me anything. As your senior, I'll listen to your worries.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d230: "Dorm life is fun and lunch is delicious, but I miss Mom's stew...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d9c0: "Dorm life is fun and lunch is delicious, but I miss Mom's stew...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d348: "Are you the new student everyone's talking about, big brother? You're a boy, so you can't live in the dorm. Poor you.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dad8: "Are you the new student everyone's talking about, big brother? You're a boy, so you can't live in the dorm. Poor you.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d428: "Because you can't have even one bite of the world's most delicious lunch. It's so sad I could cry...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dbb8: "Because you can't have even one bite of the world's most delicious lunch. It's so sad I could cry...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d554: "I just enrolled in this school, so I have no idea what a lovely lady even is.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d5f8: "Since Yggdrasil fell, it's marathons every single day. Sniff... I hate it. I want to go home.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dcd8: "I bet a lovely lady is someone with a never-give-up spirit like the Luminary who beat the Dark One!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ddbc: "So I decided to follow the older girls without complaint! Aim for the world's loveliest lady!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ded0: "A lovely lady must! Never be picky about food!!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|df48: "I tell myself green peppers are tasty shark fin and carrots are sweet strawberries, and eat every bite!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e0d8: "Pikii! I'm not a bad slime! This exercise is for picking up tiny medals beautifully and gracefully!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e1b0: "My arranged movements fit my jiggly body perfectly, so beautiful and graceful, right?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e2e8: "My mama is the Slime Queen and sends lots of letters. This letter said the following.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e3c0: "...Dearest princess, how are you? Mama is so healthy she can't stop jiggling. Slime Valley is peaceful today too.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e4a0: "Yesterday Mama and Papa held a group interview with future prince candidates to marry you. All failed. The search is rough.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e5dc: "...Honestly, Mama's too hasty! I keep telling her I'll find my own prince!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e710: "Honestly, Mama's too hasty! I keep telling her I'll find my own prince!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e7f8: "By the way, traveler, you're really handsome! I could ask Mama to recommend you as a future prince candidate!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e914: "Pikii! I'm not a bad slime! Slimes are actually pretty good at running!!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e9c8: "One of my little brothers is silver! His speed at fleeing is way faster than a horse!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|eb34: "Pikii! I'm not a bad slime. The letter from Mama is strange. Because it said this.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ec00: "...Pikii! We are the Evil Slime Gang! Daughter! Mama had her forgotten wildness awakened by the Dark One!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ecf4: "Now I feel reborn and wonderfully refreshed. I want you to feel this too.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|edc8: "Mama writing such a rough letter... it's like she's being controlled. I have a really bad feeling.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|eef4: "Since Yggdrasil fell, they say gentle monsters suddenly turn violent and ravage the world.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|efe0: "Could it be related to Mama's weird letter? I have a really bad feeling.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f144: "The ideal maiden we aim for is the bronze statue of the maiden picking up a medal, enshrined beautifully in the schoolyard!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f664: "The ideal maiden we aim for is the bronze statue of the maiden picking up a medal, enshrined beautifully in the schoolyard!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f25c: "The statue's model was Lady Rosan Crotia, the first student council president! She is the very mirror of a lovely lady!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f774: "The statue's model was Lady Rosan Crotia, the first student council president! She is the very mirror of a lovely lady!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f380: "In my family, every woman since my great-grandmother was Medal Academy council president. All proud, lovely ladies.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f48c: "I can't let the brilliant glory end with my generation. I will become council president too!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f5bc: "A lovely lady-in-the-making must face any hardship and overcome it!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f934: "I'm Orel and this is Oral. As you can see, we're twins.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fb2c: "I'm Orel and this is Oral. As you can see, we're twins.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fd6c: "I'm Orel and this is Oral. As you can see, we're twins.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f9b8: "Orel is the older sister and Oral is the younger. She's Oral and I'm Orel. Oral is me and Orel is...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fa60: "Huh? Now I can't tell who's who either.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fbb0: "You're the guest student everyone's talking about. Your silky hair is lovely. What if I fall for you?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fc68: "My sister Oral would say the same. We're twins, after all.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fdf0: "Yggdrasil fell, and we could die any time, so Oral and I made a promise.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|feb4: "If Oral dies, I'll become Oral. Then we'll be together forever.

tm.「オッケー……それじゃあ よく聴いて。\n 歌姫ガブリエルちゃんが歌います。\n: "Okay... then listen closely. Diva Gabriel will sing the Royal Medal Academy school song.
tm.「しらかばの森にー…… こもれびの花ー。\n スズランのベルを 風が鳴らすよー…: "In the birch forest... sunlit flowers. The wind rings the lily-of-the-valley bells...
tm.「ちいさなレディは 夢見るレディ……♪\n 大きな世界が わたしを待ってる？\n: "Little ladies are dreaming ladies...♪ A big world awaits me? La la la la...
tm.「歩こう……ザ・ワールド\n 集めよう トレジャー……。: "Let's walk the world... Let's gather treasure...
tm.「ラララーラー。\n メダル メダル ちいさなメダル♪\n 王立メダル女学園……: "La la la la. Medal, medal, tiny medal♪ Royal Medal Academy...
tm.「ごめんね。旅人さん。\n 今度 会う時には\n 最高の歌を聴かせてあげるからね: "Sorry, traveler. Next time we meet, I'll sing you my best song.
tm.「最近 アタマの中に\n おそろしい歌が ひびいているの。\n 旅人さん この歌: "Lately a frightening song echoes in my head. Traveler, have you ever heard this song?
tm.「我らは闇の子 暗い夜の子。\n 目覚めよ 目覚めよ 時は来たれり。: "We are children of darkness, children of the dark night. Awake, awake, the time has come.
tm.「おそれよ たたえよ 我はここにいる。\n 闇の子らの王 破滅の使者。\n 駆け: "Fear and praise, I am here. King of the children of darkness, herald of ruin. Run, gather, I am here.
tm.「……おそろしい歌 なんだろう？\n 誰かが あたしを呼んでいるのかな。\n 暗: "...What a frightening song. Is someone calling me? To a dark world of shadow...
tm.「大樹さまが お空に戻ってきてから\n あたしの心は すーっと晴れて\n 心の底: "Since Yggdrasil returned to the sky, my heart has cleared up and songs well up from deep inside!
tm.「旅人さん もし よかったら\n あたしの歌を聞いてくれる？: "Traveler, if you like, would you listen to my song?
tm.「キャー！ ありがとう！\n 歌姫ガブリエルちゃんが歌います！\n 王立メダル女: "Eek! Thank you! Diva Gabriel will sing the Royal Medal Academy school song!
tm.「そっか 残念！\n でも あたし 旅人さんのためなら\n 何度でも 歌う準備は: "I see, too bad! But for you, traveler, I'm ready to sing as many times as you like!
tm.「ガブリエルおねえさまの 歌声は\n とっても ステキだわ。: "Big sister Gabriel's singing voice is so lovely.
tm.「ほら アタシのお友達の ミっちゃんも\n お歌に かんどうしているわ。\n ス: "Look, even my friend Mimi is moved by the song. She's sniffling to hold back her tears.
tm.「ねえ ミっちゃん。\n このごろ ハンナおねえさまは\n 夜も お部屋に帰って: "Hey, Mimi. Lately big sister Hannah hasn't come back to the room at night...
tm.「夜は お外に出ちゃいけないって\n 先生に言われてるのに\n おねえさまは 何: "The teachers say we can't go outside at night, so what is big sister doing...
tm.「大樹さまが 落っこちた日から\n むやみに お外に出ちゃいけないのよ。\n も: "Since the day Yggdrasil fell, we mustn't go outside carelessly. We're preparing for emergencies.
tm.「もしもの時って どんな時なんだろうね。\n お兄ちゃん 知ってる？\n あたし: "What kind of emergency, I wonder. Do you know, big brother? I don't really get it.
tm.「メダル女学園を作ったのは\n どこかの国の王さまだって 教わったけど\n その: "I was taught that a king from some country founded Medal Academy, but I don't think he was a real king, ya see.
tm.「王さまは お金持ちのはずだから。\n ちいさなメダルなんて 地味な宝物は\n: "A king should be rich. I don't think he'd want something as plain as tiny medals as treasure, ya see.
tm.「同室のブリジットの様子が\n 最近 おかしくってねぇ～。\n 心配で 夜も眠れ: "My roommate Bridget has been acting strange lately, ya see. I'm so worried I can't sleep at night.
tm.「授業にも出ず 夜も眠らず\n 時には おいおい泣きだして\n ワケを聞いても: "She skips class, doesn't sleep at night, sometimes bursts into tears, and won't tell me why, ya see.
tm.「ふだんの ブリジットは 明るい人気者さ。\n だけど 今の あの子ときたら……: "Bridget is usually a cheerful, popular girl. But now... what on earth happened, ya see.
tm.「う～ん ブリジットってば\n こんな夜中まで ブツブツ うるさいさぁ……。: "Mmm... Bridget is mumbling this late at night again, ya see...
tm.「わたしは あきらめない とか\n まだ チャンスはあるはずよ とか\n なんの: "Things like 'I won't give up' and 'There must still be a chance'... I don't get it at all, ya see...
tm.「お兄さん トキちゃんの言うことは\n 話はんぶんに 聞いたほうがいいさぁ。\n: "Mister, take what Toki says with a grain of salt, ya see. That girl is a real tomboy.
tm.「ウチたちをおどろかせたくって\n いたずらしたり ウソをついたり\n かわいい: "She pranks us and lies to surprise us, and gets away with it all with that cute face, ya see.
tm.「わたし この学校に入学したばかりだから\n ステキなレディって いったいなんな: "I just enrolled in this school, so I have no idea what a lovely lady even is.
tm.「お姉さまがたの 言う通り\n 毎日 この体操をしていれば ホントに\n ステキ: "If I do these exercises every day like the older girls say, will I really become a lovely lady...
tm.「もしかして お兄ちゃんが ウワサの新入生？\n うふふ それじゃあ あたしのほ: "Are you the new student everyone's talking about, big brother? Hehe, then I'm a tiny bit your senior!
tm.「女の子ばかりの学校で こまったことがあったら\n あたしに なんでも言ってちょ: "If you're troubled at a girls' school, tell me anything. As your senior, I'll listen to your worries.
tm.「寮での生活は 楽しいし\n 給食は とっても おいしいけれど\n お母さんのシ: "Dorm life is fun and lunch is delicious, but I miss Mom's stew...
tm.「もしかして お兄ちゃんが ウワサの新入生？\n お兄ちゃんは 男の子だから\n: "Are you the new student everyone's talking about, big brother? You're a boy, so you can't live in the dorm. Poor you.
tm.「だって 世界一おいしい給食が\n ひとくちも 食べられないんだもの。\n 泣け: "Because you can't have even one bite of the world's most delicious lunch. It's so sad I could cry...
tm.「わたし この学校に入学したばかりだから\n ステキなレディって いったい なん: "I just enrolled in this school, so I have no idea what a lovely lady even is.
tm.「命の大樹が落っこちてから\n 毎日 毎日 マラソンばっかり。\n ぐすん……も: "Since Yggdrasil fell, it's marathons every single day. Sniff... I hate it. I want to go home.
tm.「きっと ステキなレディって\n 魔王を倒したっていう 勇者さまみたいに\n あ: "I bet a lovely lady is someone with a never-give-up spirit like the Luminary who beat the Dark One!
tm.「だから あたしも 文句を言わず\n お姉さまたちに ついていくって決めたの！\: "So I decided to follow the older girls without complaint! Aim for the world's loveliest lady!
tm.「ステキなレディ たるもの！\n 好き嫌いなんて 言語道断！！: "A lovely lady must! Never be picky about food!!
tm.「ピーマンは おいしいフカヒレ！\n ニンジンは 甘いイチゴだと\n 自分に言い: "I tell myself green peppers are tasty shark fin and carrots are sweet strawberries, and eat every bite!
tm.「ピキー！ あちき わるいスライムじゃないわ！\n この体操はね ちいさなメダル: "Pikii! I'm not a bad slime! This exercise is for picking up tiny medals beautifully and gracefully!
tm.「あちきの このアレンジのきいた動き。\n プルッとした身体に ぴったりで\n: "My arranged movements fit my jiggly body perfectly, so beautiful and graceful, right?
tm.「あちきのママは スライムの女王さまで\n 手紙をたくさん送ってくれるの。\n: "My mama is the Slime Queen and sends lots of letters. This letter said the following.
tm.「……愛する プリンセス お元気ですか？\n ママは元気すぎて プルプルが止まり: "...Dearest princess, how are you? Mama is so healthy she can't stop jiggling. Slime Valley is peaceful today too.
tm.「昨日 ママとパパは あなたと結婚をする\n 未来の王子さま候補と 集団面接をし: "Yesterday Mama and Papa held a group interview with future prince candidates to marry you. All failed. The search is rough.
tm.「……まったくもう ママったら気が早いわ！\n あちきの王子さまは 自分で見つけ: "...Honestly, Mama's too hasty! I keep telling her I'll find my own prince!
tm.「まったくもう ママったら 気が早いんだから\n あちきの王子さまは 自分で見つ: "Honestly, Mama's too hasty! I keep telling her I'll find my own prince!
tm.「ところで 旅人さん とってもイケメンね！\n ママに頼んで 未来の王子さま候補: "By the way, traveler, you're really handsome! I could ask Mama to recommend you as a future prince candidate!
tm.「ピキー！ あちき わるいスライムじゃないわ！\n こう見えて スライム族は\n: "Pikii! I'm not a bad slime! Slimes are actually pretty good at running!!
tm.「あちきの弟の中にも 銀色の子がいてね！\n その子の 逃げ足の速さときたら\n: "One of my little brothers is silver! His speed at fleeing is way faster than a horse!
tm.「ピキー！ あちき わるいスライムじゃないわ。\n ママから届いた 手紙の内容が: "Pikii! I'm not a bad slime. The letter from Mama is strange. Because it said this.
tm.「……ぴきーっ！ 我らは 悪のスライム団！\n 娘よ！ 母は 忘れかけていた野生: "...Pikii! We are the Evil Slime Gang! Daughter! Mama had her forgotten wildness awakened by the Dark One!
tm.「今は 生まれかわった気分で\n とても すがすがしい 心もちです。\n あなた: "Now I feel reborn and wonderfully refreshed. I want you to feel this too.
tm.「ママが こんなに 乱暴な文章を書くなんて\n まるで何かに 操られているみたい: "Mama writing such a rough letter... it's like she's being controlled. I have a really bad feeling.
tm.「大樹が地に落ちてからというもの\n おとなしい魔物が 急に 凶暴になって\n: "Since Yggdrasil fell, they say gentle monsters suddenly turn violent and ravage the world.
tm.「ママのヘンテコな手紙と\n もしかして 関係があるのかな？\n なんだか とっ: "Could it be related to Mama's weird letter? I have a really bad feeling.
tm.「あたくしたちが目指す 理想の乙女の姿とは\n 校庭に 美しく鎮座まします\n: "The ideal maiden we aim for is the bronze statue of the maiden picking up a medal, enshrined beautifully in the schoolyard!
tm.「銅像のモデルは 初代生徒会長であらせられた\n レディ・ローザン・クロティアさ: "The statue's model was Lady Rosan Crotia, the first student council president! She is the very mirror of a lovely lady!
tm.「我が家は ひいおばあさまの代から 全員が\n メダ女の卒業生で 生徒会長でした: "In my family, every woman since my great-grandmother was Medal Academy council president. All proud, lovely ladies.
tm.「あたくしの代で かがやかしい栄光を\n 途切れさせるワケには まいりません。\: "I can't let the brilliant glory end with my generation. I will become council president too!
tm.「ステキなレディのタマゴたるもの\n どんな困難にも 立ち向かい\n 乗り越えて: "A lovely lady-in-the-making must face any hardship and overcome it!
tm.「わたしがオレルで この子がオラル。\n わたしたち 見ての通りの双子なの。: "I'm Orel and this is Oral. As you can see, we're twins.
tm.「オレルが姉で オラルが妹。\n あの子が オラルで わたしが オレル。\n オ: "Orel is the older sister and Oral is the younger. She's Oral and I'm Orel. Oral is me and Orel is...
tm.「あれ？ どっちが どっちだか\n わたしも わからなくなっちゃった。: "Huh? Now I can't tell who's who either.
tm.「あなたが ウワサの客員生徒さんでしょう。\n サラサラヘアーが とってもステキ: "You're the guest student everyone's talking about. Your silky hair is lovely. What if I fall for you?
tm.「妹のオラルも そう言うはずよ。\n だって わたしたち 双子なんだもん。: "My sister Oral would say the same. We're twins, after all.
tm.「大樹が地面に落っこちて\n わたしたちも いつ死んじゃうかわからないから\n: "Yggdrasil fell, and we could die any time, so Oral and I made a promise.
tm.「オラルが死んだら わたしが オラルになるの。\n それなら ふたりは ずっと一: "If Oral dies, I'll become Oral. Then we'll be together forever.
